passing_score.verbatim: You must take a vision, knowledge, and skills test when you apply for an original driver's license or upgrade to a different class.

exam_facts.note: The manual (physical p15, printed 1-10) requires a vision, knowledge and skills test for an original license, says vision and knowledge tests may be taken at any SCDMV branch, bans manuals, testing aids, talking, leaving the area and electronic devices during the knowledge test, and names One Stop third-party testers for first-time Class D; physical p16 (printed 1-11) says every first license test includes vision, knowledge and skills except a moped license. Physical p17 (printed 1-12) says the knowledge test covers traffic laws, road signs and driving safety rules. It states NO question count, NO passing score or percent and NO time limit anywhere (full-text search for pass/percent/questions/correct/score found none) - nulls are genuine absences, not imported from memory. Section 12 (physical pp139-140) is a practice-app note plus 10 sample questions, not the exam format, and is not mapped. Printed page ids are section-style (n-m); physical = printed body page + offset per section.
